description:
Cobol Developer 
 Req number: 
R8885 
 Employment type: 
Full time 
 Worksite flexibility: 
Remote 
 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
As a Cobol Developer, you will build a new pooled-account structure inside a running z/OS core. 
 Job Description 
 CAI is seeking a Cobol Developer to build a new pooled-account structure inside a running z/OS core, without disturbing the balances already on it. This position is contract and remote. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Analyze the current account master, posting, and balance-maintenance programs to establish where composite reservoir accounts must be recognized, and document what you find
 Design and code the new account type end to end: master file and table structures, account opening and closing, participant linkage, sweep and reverse-sweep logic, allocation and interest apportionment, and closing balance derivation
 Modify batch COBOL programs and JCL and extend the nightly and month-end cycles to include the new processing without lengthening the batch window beyond agreed limits
 Add new CRAs to the audit trail, exception reporting, and reconciliation controls the new function requires, working with accounting stakeholders on what must be evidenced
 Produce test data, unit and regression test packs, and parallel-run comparisons against current production output; investigate every difference until it is explained
 Support implementation, conversion of any in-scope existing accounts, and early-life production runs, including on-call cover during the first cycles
 Leave behind program documentation, data-flow notes, and runbook updates that the support team can work from
 What You'll Need 
 Required:
 5+ years of Enterprise COBOL development experience in a z/OS environment (batch & online) 
 5+ Years of Experience with NaturalOne; developing, debugging, and deploying
 Experience with Natural programs, subprograms, and maps
 3+ years of JCL development and production support experience 
 3+ years of experience with financial/accounting systems development or support including double-entry posting, balance/accrual maintenance, value dating, reconciliation, and month-end closeouts in a regulated environment
 3+ years of experience working with VSAM and Adabas including file design and performance behavior 
 3+ years of experience with tracing undocumented logic through copybooks, call chains, and job streams 
 Preferred:
 Experience with cash management, account pooling, sweeps, or treasury applications 
 Experience with CA-7 scheduling and batch operations 
 Experience with REXX, Python, or Java
 Degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state and local standards
 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings
 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor
 
 #LI-AE1

 If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employment selection process, please direct your inquiries to application.accommodations@cai.io or (888) 824 – 8111.
